title: invoice.create_invoice payload
description: Issues an invoice from its lines. MONEY (`unit_price`) = integer MINOR UNITS (cents, ADR-0007/0123): 3,30 € is 330. `quantity` = FIXED-POINT integer, global scale 10⁶ (ADR-0147): one unit is 1000000 and 0,5 kg is 500000 — a bare `2` means 0,000002 units, which prices to 0,00 € and is REJECTED here (invoice#49). The `tax_rate` a caller sends is a HINT: the rate actually charged and declared comes from the rule resolved for `tax_category_key` (invoice#27, ADR-0223).

quantity.description: Fixed-point integer, global scale 10⁶ (ADR-0147): 1 unit = 1000000, 0,5 = 500000. The floor is 1000 (a thousandth of a unit): below that no invoiceable line exists and the value is a scale mistake, not a quantity.

unit_price.description: Price of ONE unit in integer minor units (cents, ADR-0123): 3,30 € is 330.
